claims.name: standalone-ast-construction-descriptions
claims.statement: The standalone AST construction collector passes77 supplied-tree assertions and15 effective semantic source inverses. Actual capture/callback/returned-root/reachable-node identities, detached descriptions, public AST, argument aliases, callback count/context/error and nested fatal restoration are verified. An actual lifetime RED exposes snapshot back-edge retention after original cyclic metadata is broken; identity-only aliases fix release, and the restored back-edge fails the same oracle. The initial74/14 draft and actual producers remain preserved. Ten guarded live consumer suites, three actual public Toolbox lowering routes and eight reason-sensitive evidence RED controls pass; only Parser changes production. The prior diagnosis claim preserves all134 original inputs at f61130d by mode/revision only.
claims.scope: Standalone descriptive construction channel only. It grants no original event/argument source authority and is not integrated with emission producers or mapping. Original absent-interface RED proves availability; actual lifetime RED and semantic source inverses establish behavior. Plain hash/array snapshots compare identity/data; opaque references are retained by identity without inspecting third-party internals. Ten direct consumers are guarded live parent-source recurrence, reusing standard toolchain and published dependency outputs, not immutable full Phase0/dependency reproduction. Original-frame/factory joining, typed builders, packet composition, full Phase0, mapped repair, public runtime fix, recurring CI and independent canonical admission remain open.
